statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41506 (GO-2026-5105, GHSA-3xc5-wrhm-f963): go-git's smart-HTTP transport follows a redirect of the initial /info/refs request to a different host and keeps sending the original credentials to it, so a malicious or compromised Git server can capture them. It is fixed in go-git 5.18.0, which adds a followRedirects policy whose default only follows the initial request. The Go vulnerability database lists github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/transport/http NewClient as the affected symbol. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5105, https://github.com/go-git/go-git/security/advisories/GHSA-3xc5-wrhm-f963, https://github.com/go-git/go-git/releases/tag/v5.18.0, v5 fix commit https://github.com/go-git/go-git/commit/bcd20a9c525826081262a06a9ed9c3167abfcd53 . We checked every published trivy-fips package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine security repository, where the FIPS packages are published: 38 builds, 0.69.1-r0 to the current 0.74.0-r12, each for x86_64 and aarch64, each verified against the repository index checksum. Each package holds one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 and the Go FIPS 140-3 module (GOFIPS140=v1.0.0-c2097c7c). We read its Go build information (go version -m) and its function table (go tool nm), and searched its raw bytes, which also finds the names of inlined functions. The Go build information lists github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 5.16.5 in builds up to 0.69.3-r3 and 5.17.1 in 0.69.3-r4 and 0.69.3-r5, inside the affected range, and 5.18.0 to 5.19.2 from 0.69.3-r6 on. plumbing/transport/http.NewClient is in the function table of every build, so the vulnerable code is linked and the range follows the module version. The fix's new functions in that package, checkRedirect, isInitialRequest, endpointHost and endpointPort, are present in every build from 0.69.3-r6 on and absent from every earlier build; in 0.69.3-r5 the binary's source-file paths for that package name go-git v5.17.1, and in 0.69.3-r6 they name v5.18.0. 0.69.3-r6 is the first build that carries the fix.
